== Summary ==
[[Brian Terwilliger]] with [[Team Albany]] at [[DecipherCon 1999]] (Wild Card day, 11 November 1999). Photo: Decipher. Cropped from [[:File:Team Albany DecipherCon 1999.jpg]] (white cap and glasses, second from left).

Identification: Decipher's caption names "the Terwilligers". Bill Bisco (personal communication, 25 October 2026) identified this player as Brian Terwilliger. The face matches Brian Terwilliger in [[:File:Team Albany 2000 Team Championship.jpg]].
